title: subagent-policy config
description: Per-repo or per-user override for the subagent-policy skill's defaults. Loaded by orchestrator skills (auto-pilot, parallel-orchestrator, conductor, etc.) before dispatching Agent(...) calls.

runtime_preference.description: Which runtime's model names should be used when this skill resolves a tier to a concrete model identifier.

tier_models.description: Override the default model identifier for each tier per runtime. Partial maps are allowed — unspecified runtimes fall back to the skill default.

tier_reasoning_effort.description: Reasoning-effort modifier per tier per runtime. Used by Codex (gpt-5.4-mini, gpt-5.5) and Gemini (gemini-2.5-*) where the same model name appears across tiers and reasoning effort is the differentiator. Claude does not use this — model names are tier-specific.

max_parallel_default.description: Soft default for concurrent MED/HIGH subagents. No enforced ceiling — operator-tunable via this config.

max_parallel_low_tier.description: Soft default for concurrent LOW-tier (read-only) subagents. No enforced ceiling — operator-tunable via this config.

force_tier.description: Escape hatch — pin every subagent to this tier regardless of classifier output. Use only for cost emergencies. Set to null to use the classifier normally.

force_model.description: Escape hatch — pin every subagent to this exact model string. Bypasses tier classification entirely. Use with extreme care.

tier_overrides.description: Per-subagent-type or per-skill tier override. Keys are matchers like 'subagent_type:slice-reviewer' or 'skill:slice-build'. Highest priority after force_*.

claude.description: Claude model identifier (e.g., haiku-4-5, sonnet-4-6, opus-4-7).

codex.description: Codex model identifier (e.g., gpt-5.4-mini, gpt-5.5, gpt-5.4).
